scenarios.title: A｜同事抢功
scenarios.setting: 团队会议中，同事把玩家主要完成的方案说成了自己的工作。

turns.text: I redesigned the first part of the presentation and came up with the new layout.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. Jamie and I worked on it together, and I handled most of the new layout.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Jamie and I worked on it together, and I handled most of the new layout.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Just to clarify, I was responsible for the layout changes in the first section.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to clarify, I was responsible for the layout changes in the first section.
feedback.explanation: “responsible for”表示负责某项工作，能用来确认任务归属。

choices.text: I’m glad you like it. I actually worked on that part yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m glad you like it. I actually worked on that part yesterday.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Jamie helped with the content, and I put together the new visual layout.

feedback.naturalExpression: Jamie helped with the content, and I put together the new visual layout.
feedback.explanation: “together”强调双方一起参与或同处一处，适合商量共同安排。

choices.text: Actually, I did all of that, not Jamie.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Jamie and I worked on it together, and I handled most of the new layout.
feedback.explanation: 如果要澄清贡献，提供自己完成的具体部分更有说服力；“all … not Jamie”容易让公开讨论变成对抗。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. Jamie’s feedback on the content was helpful too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Jamie’s feedback on the content was helpful too.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Thank you. I’m happy with how it turned out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’m happy with how it turned out.
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Thanks. I can walk you through the changes if you’d like.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I can walk you through the changes if you’d like.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.prompt: 关于「功劳与责任争议」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hey, I wanted to talk about what happened in the meeting earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I wanted to talk about what happened in the meeting earlier.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: I felt like my contribution wasn’t very clear in the meeting. Could we make sure we give each other credit for our parts?

feedback.naturalExpression: I felt like my contribution wasn’t very clear in the meeting. Could we make sure we give each other credit for our parts?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Next time, could we be a little clearer about who worked on what?

feedback.naturalExpression: Next time, could we be a little clearer about who worked on what?
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: I’d appreciate it if my contribution was acknowledged too.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate it if my contribution was acknowledged too.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

scenarios.title: B｜同事甩锅
scenarios.setting: 一个任务出现问题，同事告诉经理是玩家没有及时完成自己的部分。

turns.text: We missed the deadline because Alex didn’t send me the final files in time.

turns.prompt: 对方想了解出了什么问题，你会怎样说明情况？

choices.text: I actually sent the files yesterday afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: I actually sent the files yesterday afternoon.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己实际发送文件的时间，让贡献或进度有可核实的依据。

choices.text: I sent my part at around three yesterday, before the deadline.

feedback.naturalExpression: I sent my part at around three yesterday, before the deadline.
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

choices.text: Just to clarify, my part was completed and sent yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to clarify, my part was completed and sent yesterday.
feedback.explanation: 先说明是在核对理解，再复述关键信息，便于对方纠正听错或记错的细节。

choices.text: I can show you the message where I sent the files.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can show you the message where I sent the files.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: That’s not true. Jamie is lying.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I actually sent the files yesterday afternoon.
feedback.explanation: 直接说“lying”认定对方有意欺骗；先指出记录与说法的差异，更便于核实事实。

turns.text: I didn’t see them until this morning.

turns.prompt: 你想提供文件发送记录，澄清交接时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: I sent them in the project chat at 3:12 yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I sent them in the project chat at 3:12 yesterday.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Maybe the message was missed, but the files were sent yesterday afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe the message was missed, but the files were sent yesterday afternoon.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I can resend them now, but I did send them before the deadline.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can resend them now, but I did send them before the deadline.
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

choices.text: Perhaps we should confirm where files should be sent next time so this doesn’t happen again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perhaps we should confirm where files should be sent next time so this doesn’t happen again.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

turns.text: Okay. Let’s make sure everyone confirms receipt next time.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: That works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Sure. I’ll ask for confirmation next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll ask for confirmation next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: Agreed. That should help avoid confusion.

feedback.naturalExpression: Agreed. That should help avoid confusion.
feedback.explanation: 先表示同意，再说明能减少混淆，确认双方对方案作用的理解一致。

scenarios.title: C｜向领导说明事实
scenarios.setting: 问题没有解决，玩家决定单独找经理说明情况。

turns.text: Do you have a few minutes? I’d like to clarify what happened with yesterday’s deadline.

turns.prompt: 关于「功劳与责任争议」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I want to make sure you have the full picture.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to make sure you have the full picture.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: I think there may have been some misunderstanding about what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think there may have been some misunderstanding about what happened.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’d like to explain my side of what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to explain my side of what happened.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I don’t want to blame anyone, but I’d like to clarify the timeline.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to blame anyone, but I’d like to clarify the timeline.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I need to tell you the truth about Jamie.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I want to make sure you have the full picture.
feedback.explanation: 以“关于 Jamie 的真相”开头容易变成评价个人；围绕具体事件和证据，更能说明工作问题。

turns.prompt: 你想按时间顺序向领导说明事情经过，会怎么说？

choices.text: I finished my part at 2:45 and sent the files at 3:12.

feedback.naturalExpression: I finished my part at 2:45 and sent the files at 3:12.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Jamie asked me for the files yesterday morning, and I sent them that afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Jamie asked me for the files yesterday morning, and I sent them that afternoon.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: Here’s the message showing when I sent them.**

feedback.naturalExpression: Here’s the message showing when I sent them.**
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: After that, I didn’t hear that there was a problem until this morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: After that, I didn’t hear that there was a problem until this morning.
feedback.explanation: “this morning”明确是哪一天的时段，谈当前日期时前面不必加介词。

turns.text: I see. So your part was finished before the deadline?

turns.prompt: 关于「功劳与责任争议」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. I can show you the file history as well if that helps.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I can show you the file history as well if that helps.
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

choices.text: Yes. I just wanted to make sure the timeline was clear.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I just wanted to make sure the timeline was clear.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: That’s right. I’m not trying to blame anyone; I just don’t want there to be a misunderstanding about my work.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s right. I’m not trying to blame anyone; I just don’t want there to be a misunderstanding about my work.
feedback.explanation: “not trying to”澄清自己没有某种意图，能在提出疑问前减少对方的防御感。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks for hearing me out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for hearing me out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: I appreciate it. I’d also like to avoid the same problem happening again.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate it. I’d also like to avoid the same problem happening again.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Thanks. Maybe we could agree on a clearer handoff process next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Maybe we could agree on a clearer handoff process next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。
